async def act(page):
    # Hover over the Reports link to expand its menu
    reports_link = page.get_by_role("menubar").get_by_role("link", name="\ue80a Reports")
    await reports_link.hover()
    # Wait a bit for the menu to appear
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    # Click on the 'By Products' link under the reviews menu
    # Based on the tree, navigate through the menu hierarchy: menubar -> menu -> menu -> link
    by_products_link = page.get_by_role("menubar").get_by_role("menu").get_by_role("menu").get_by_role("link", name="By Products")
    await by_products_link.click()
    # Wait for the page to load after navigation
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    return
